info.prompt: Cinematic wide shot of the lattice during a gravity flip, tiles sliding diagonally as the platformer node activates. The HUD elements fracture into {crimson speed lines|heat distortion shimmers|neon afterimages}, while the hero's journey keys transition the background from blue to red. Gothic spires extrude from nodes, their shadows stretching across the mathematical grid. {Dutch angle emphasizing chaos|Static shot with motion blur from cascading tile collapses|Over-the-shoulder POV of a custom die being slotted into the sandbox}.
